summary: Third Sphere is an early-stage investor in founders upgrading broken global systems, from infrastructure and supply chains to energy, water and cities. Its Funds page says it invests at pre-seed and seed and stays close to founders, and describes related initiatives such as a non-dilutive capital database and the URBAN-X programme it ran from 2017 to 2021. Check size, geography, an application route and a street address are not stated on the pages reviewed.

investmentEvidence.fact: The Funds page says Third Sphere ran sourcing, selection and investment at URBAN-X from 2017 to 2021 and that over 90% of backed startups raised follow-on funding.

sources.title: Funds page: pre-seed and seed stage, climate systems thesis and initiatives
